title: COSI — Setup Response Payload
description: Payload for setup-corrugator/setup-converting response messages. Correlation to the originating setup message is done via envelope correlationID, not via setup identifiers in payload.

ErrorItem.description: One error linked to a setup field. Manufacturer-specific error classification is intentionally open (no standardised code list).

fieldRef.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer rooted at the original full setup message identified by correlationID, e.g. /payload/orders/0/sheetWidth/value. Zero-based array indices; escape ~ as ~0 and / as ~1. JSON string form, not a URI fragment or dotted path.

manufacturerCode.description: Manufacturer-defined error code. Open value set by design.

result.description: Processing ok for the correlated setup message.
Processing failed for the correlated setup message; details in errors.

errors.description: One or multiple errors returned for this setup.
